headline: CAF Reports Significant Revenue Growth And Profit In Abuja Assembly
metaDescription: The Confederation of African Football reported a profit of $31.2 million and revenue surpassing $280 million during the 48th General Assembly in Abuja.
aiSummaryBullets: The Confederation of African Football reached a net profit of $31.2 million for the latest period.
Total organization revenue exceeded $280 million, marking a growth of over 200 percent.
Financial results were disclosed during the 48th Ordinary General Assembly hosted in Abuja, Nigeria.
aiContextParagraph: The Confederation of African Football (CAF) announced a notable shift in its financial performance during its 48th Ordinary General Assembly, which took place in Abuja, Nigeria, on November 21, 2026. According to the presented figures, the organization achieved a total revenue exceeding $280 million, representing a substantial increase of more than 200 percent. Furthermore, the governing body reported a net profit of $31.2 million. Officials attributed these financial improvements to a series of reforms implemented under current leadership aimed at reversing a period of prolonged financial instability. This assembly served as the platform for presenting these updated financial records to member nations and stakeholders, highlighting the organization's recovery from previous fiscal challenges and its current trajectory towards improved economic health within continental football operations.
whyItIsViral: This story is circulating due to reports in two independent media outlets following the high-profile assembly meeting in Nigeria.

sources.articleTitle: CAF revenue exceeds USD 280 million and USD 31 million profit as revealed in the 48th Ordinary General Assembly in Nigeria
CAF records $31.2 million profit as Motsepe’s reforms drive financial turnaround
